title: Mosaic Shift problem (3x3 cyclic row/column shifts)

initial_tiles.description: A permutation of tile fragment IDs 0..8 in row-major board order.

$comment: Action contract: kind shift_line, actor_id row-<line> or col-<line>, params {axis:[0|1], line:[0..2], delta:[-1|1]}, with a state_hash precondition. Positive delta moves right/down with visible wrap-around. Uniqueness is one exact shortest ordered sequence under mosaic-exact-action-order-v1, proven by bounded complete BFS through depth 8.
